counts.distinct_parents.scope: Accepted child exposure counts each settled paid round and innermost owning episode once, independent of repeated visits, zero-valued children, exit filtering or empty reduction identities. counts.feature_entries.scope: Settled feature/transition entries and reached exits remain separate from cancelled/failed paid-round boundary exposure. Interrupted counts include closed instances and censored open instances, retain entry-selected cohorts without numeric children, and never alter payout statistics or settled-parent turnover. Nesting/boundary faults withhold completeness; cohort overflow withholds the breakdown. The native dashboard can select interruption counters, and live/reloaded/saved evidence agrees in both engines. Resource deadlines currently classify as cancellation; detailed stop attribution remains a separate feature-exit workflow.
